subject: Reschedule: Pilot demo — prioritization shift & async fallback options
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucy Zhao <lucy.zhao@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot demo today — quick update / options

Hi Lucy —

Quick note — we were in the meeting room at the top of the hour for the pilot walkthrough but I think something came up on your side and we missed you. No problem — I know schedules tilt during release weeks.

We still want to respect your team's time and priorities. A few options to keep momentum without asking you to rebook a full 60m right away:

- Option A: Short 20m engineering touchpoint (recorded) this week — quick architecture + integration checklist.
- Option B: Convert the session to an async recording + annotated agenda; we can follow up with a 30m Q&A later.
- Option C: Office-hours slot with our engineers (no slides) — pick a 15m window from the list below and we'll drop in.

If you prefer to just reschedule a full demo, send three 30–60m windows that work and Ben/Monica will align. I attached the pilot agenda in case it helps prioritize.

Suggested office-hours windows (PDT): Tue 2:30–3:00pm, Wed 11:00–11:15am, Thu 4:30–4:45pm.

Thanks — and happy to be flexible.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: acme_pilot_agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Lucy Zhao <lucy.zhao@acme-analytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: salesops@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo today — quick update / options

Hi Hannah —

So sorry — we had an emergency rollback on our side for the sprint release and the team was pulled into war room mode. Really appreciate you holding the slot.

Option B sounds ideal right now: please record the walkthrough and share any short notes we can scan. We can follow up with a 30m Q&A once the release stabilizes (probably late next week).

If possible, could Ben capture a 10–12 minute recorded walkthrough focused on deployment/permissions and a 5-minute architecture summary? That would help our SRE and infra teams.

Thanks for being flexible. I’ll loop back with windows for a Q&A once things calm down.

— Lucy
Lucy Zhao
Product Manager, Integrations | Acme Analytics
lucy.zhao@acme-analytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lucy Zhao <lucy.zhao@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo today — quick update / options

Hi Lucy —

Totally understand — thanks for the heads up. Happy to put together a concise recording that hits:

1) Deployment and permission checklist (2–3 slides / terminal demo)
2) KV cache behavior and expected latency numbers in a typical onboarding stack (short snippet)
3) Options for private deployment (VPC on-prem checklist) + how we handle model pinning during rollouts

I’ll record a ~12 minute walkthrough and upload to the Drive. Monica — can you also prepare a one-page integration checklist for their SREs? I’ll attach both.

Lucy — once you’re ready, we can either: 1) schedule a 30m Q&A next week, or 2) put you into our Thursday engineer office-hours (15m) — I’ve attached an .ics if you want the office-hours option.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: office-hours-invite.ics

From: Lucy Zhao <lucy.zhao@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: salesops@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo today — quick update / options

Ben / Hannah —

Thank you — that plan works perfectly. We’ll review the recording and the checklist. For the Q&A, tentatively propose next Thursday 10:00–10:30am PT; I’ll confirm by Friday morning once the release is out of triage.

Appreciate the responsiveness — the short recording + checklist minimizes context switching for our ops folks.

Regards,
Lucy
